messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick update for folks who travel internationally for work — two policy changes go into effect May 1.
Maya (People Ops): 1) All international business trips now require approval via the Travel Request form at least 7 business days before departure (exceptions need manager + People Ops sign-off).
Maya (People Ops): 2) Per diem caps updated by region — meals/incidentals will be reimbursed up to the new caps in the policy doc. For high-cost regions an additional lodging approval step is needed.
Maya (People Ops): We also added a mandatory short Safety & Conduct module for anyone traveling for >=3 nights internationally. Should take ~20 minutes. Completion is required before travel.
Maya (People Ops): Docs and the region-specific per-diem table: https://intranet.redwood.com/policies/travel-2026 (link)
Leo (Sales): Thanks — can we still request exceptions for client-paid hotels?
Maya (People Ops): Yes — client-paid accommodations are fine, but still submit the Travel Request and note the client is covering X. Finance will need a note for invoicing.
Jordan (Finance): FYI, expense codes change — use EXP-INTL (meals) / EXP-INTL-LOD (lodging). If people use old codes they may get delayed reimbursements.
Samir (Eng): Quick Q: I have a conference in 4 days — do I need the new module before leaving?
Maya (People Ops): If your trip departs before May 1, follow the current policy. If it departs on/after May 1 you need the module completed beforehand. For urgent cases hit me or your manager and well triage.
hr-bot: Reminder: Safety & Conduct module assigned to travelers starting 2026-05-01. Completion recorded in LMS.
Leo (Sales): :thumbsup: Where do we see the per-diem numbers by city?
Maya (People Ops): Per-diem table is in the doc (search for "Region caps"). Example snippets below:
```
Region: Western Europe — meals cap €85/day, lodging approval needed > €250/night
Region: APAC Tier 1 — meals cap ¥9,000/day, lodging approval needed > ¥30,000/night
```
Samir (Eng): Got it, thanks. Will forward to the team.
Jordan (Finance): We'll update the expense templates and the Concur mappings this week. Ping finance if you see any delays.
Maya (People Ops): We know this changes some workflows — AMA office hours tomorrow 11am PT in #people-ops for quick Qs.
Samir (Eng): I'll try to make the AMA. Thanks!
Leo (Sales): One more — does this affect personal travel with expense reimbursements for recruiting?
Maya (People Ops): Reimbursements for personal travel used for recruiting still need pre-approval and must follow the per-diem caps. If in doubt, submit the Travel Request and select "Recruiting" as purpose.
hr-bot: Action item: all travelers with trips on/after 2026-05-01 must complete Safety & Conduct module before travel.
Maya (People Ops): Appreciate everyone's patience — we put these in place to streamline approvals and keep everyone safe. Reach out to me or @Jordan for urgent exceptions. :wave:
